SELECT SUM(COALESCE(pf.previous_balance,0)) AS TotalPreviousBalance, SUM(COALESCE(pf.reduced_purchase_amount,0) + COALESCE(pf.standard_purchase_amount,0)) AS TotalPurchase, SUM(COALESCE(pf.reduced_return_amount,0) + COALESCE(pf.standard_return_amount,0)) AS TotalReturns, SUM(COALESCE(pf.reduced_discount_amount,0) + COALESCE(pf.standard_discount_amount,0)) AS TotalDiscounts, SUM(COALESCE(pf.reduced_tax_amount,0) + COALESCE(pf.standard_taxamount,0)) AS TotalTax, SUM(COALESCE(pf.payment_amount,0)) AS TotalPayments, SUM(COALESCE(pf.current_balance,0)) AS TotalCurrentBalance FROM payables_file AS pf WHERE pf.year_month = ':1' AND ( (:2 = 0 AND ( :4 = 0 OR pf.supplier_id BETWEEN :3 AND :4 ))
OR pf.supplier_id = :2 OR pf.supplier_id IN ( SELECT s.id FROM supplier AS s WHERE s.payment_destination_id = :2 ) );

DELETE FROM payables_file AS pf WHERE pf.year_month = ':1' AND ( ( :2 <> 0 AND ( pf.supplier_id = :2 OR pf.supplier_id IN ( SELECT s.id FROM supplier s WHERE s.payment_destination_id = :2 ) )) OR ( :2 = 0 AND ( :4 = 0 OR pf.supplier_id BETWEEN ':3' AND ':4' ) ) );

UPDATE incoming_delivery AS i SET i.payment_due_date = NULL WHERE i.id > 0 AND i.payment_due_date = ':4' AND ( (:1 = 0 AND i.payee_id BETWEEN :2 AND :3) OR i.payee_id = :1 OR i.payee_id IN ( SELECT s.id FROM supplier AS s WHERE s.payment_destination_id = :1 ) );

UPDATE disbursement AS d SET d.payment_due_date = NULL WHERE d.id > 0 AND d.payment_due_date = ':4' AND ( (:1 = 0 AND ( :3 = 0 OR d.payment_destination_id BETWEEN :2 AND :3 )) OR d.payment_destination_id = :1 OR d.payment_destination_id IN ( SELECT s.id FROM supplier AS s WHERE s.payment_destination_id = :1 ) );
